use_when: dynamic workforce composition or established multi-agent society patterns materially improve the task
avoid_when: a single agent or fixed host-native subagents are sufficient

notes: Prefer the basic `camel-ai` package first; add extras only for features the project actually uses.
CAMEL documents broader `[all]` installs, but AAOP should not choose them by default.

credentials: model-provider credential only when required by the selected model
permissions: tool and environment permissions required by the selected workforce only

checks: run a minimal workforce/agent collaboration that exercises the reason CAMEL was selected
confirm the original capability gap is closed

steps: remove the camel-ai dependency with the project package manager
remove provider-specific configuration added only for the workforce

warnings: Do not install `camel-ai[all]` unless multiple optional feature groups are actually needed.
